content: Yuhuda Yeleta Zarkke
Yuhuda zereththati Paareese, Hexiroome, Karme, Huurenne Shobaale.
Shobaaley Era7aye yelides; Era7ayeykka Yahaate yelides; Yahaateykka Xora7aatas koyro aawa gididayta Ahumayenne Lahade yelides.

Huurey ba aayo Efraatas bayra naa; Huurey Beeteliheeme yelides; Exaame attuma nayti Izra7eele, Yushimanne Yidibaashe; isttas michcha Haxilelipoono geetettawus; Panu7eeley Gadoore yelides. Ezeerey Huushe yelides; hayti Huure zareta.
Tequhe aawa Ashihuures Heelonne Na7iro geetettiza nam7u machcheti deettes.
Ashihuurey Na7iro geetettiza ba machcheyfe Ahuzaame, Hefeere, Temenanne Ahashitaare geetettiza attuma nayta yelides.
Qasseka Heelippe Xerete, Xoohaare, Etinanne Qoxe yelides.
Haqoxey Anuube, Xobaabenne Haruume naa Aharheele zereththatas aawa.
Yabeexey ba ishata giddon keehi bonchchettida as gidides; iza aaya, «Tani iita miixan yelidayssa» gashe iza, «Yaabexe» ga sunththadus.
Yabeexeykka, «Abeet Godawu! Ne tana anjja; ne ta deraa aassa; ne kushey tanara de7o; tana metoppenne qohoppe ashsha» giidi Isra7eele Xoossaa woossides; Xoossika izi woossidayssa izas immides.
Hara Asata Yeleta Zarkke
Shuhaha isha Kaalubey Mahire yelides; Mahirey Eshtoone yelides.
Eshtooney Beeti-Rafa, Fasahenne Ir-Nahaashe aawa Tahina geetettiza attuma nayta yelides; Tahinay Na7aashe geetettiza katama essides; heyta zereththati kase Arakka geetettiza deren deettes.
Qanaazey Otin7eelenne Saraya geetettiza nam7u attuma nayta yelides; Otin7eeleykka Hataatenne Ma7onotaye geetettiza nam7u attuma nayta yelides.
Ma7onotayey Oofira yelides. Sarayaykka kushe hiillanchchati diza Geharishimo geetettiza katamayo essida Iyo7aabe yelides.
Yoofine naa Kaalebey Iro, Eelanne Na7ema geetettiza attuma nayta yelides; Eelay Qenaaze yelides.
Yuhalel7eeley Ziife, Ziifa, Tiriyanne Asar7eele geetettiza attuma nayta yelides.
Eziray Yootore, Mereede, Eferenne Yaloone yelides; Mereedey Gibxe kawo nayo Bityo machcho ekkidi Maaramo geetettiza macca nayo, Shamayenne Eshttamo7a aawa Yishiba yelides.
Mereedey Gadoore aawa Yaareede, Sooko aawa Heebere, Zaanohe aawa Yiquti7eele Ayhuda dere maccassayfe yelides; heytikka Gibxe kawo nayo Bitya Mereedes yelida zareta.
Hoddiyay Nahaamo michcho ekkides; iza Garimite dere as Qi7ila aawaanne Ma7ikate dere as Eshttamo7a aawa yeladus.
Shimooni Aminoone, Eraane, Beeni-Hanaanenne Tilone yelides; Yishi7ey Zoheetenne Beeni-Zoheete yelides.
Seela Nayta Zarkke
Yuhuda naa Seela zareti Lekka aawaa Eera, Mareesha aawaa Laadanne Beeti-Ashibe7a katamaan de7iza layno daddizayta qommotas aawa.
Harati qasse Yoqiime, Iyo7aasa, Yashubiliheeme, Mo7aabe biitta haarida Saraafanne Kozeebe katama asata; (ha yeletata taarike mazgabay beniisofe dees.)
Istti kawo keeththa oosos urqqa medhdhizayta gididi kase Naxaamenne Gadeere geetettiza katamatan de7ida.
Simoona Nayta Zarkke
Simooni Namu7eele, Yaamine, Yaribe, Zaraahenne Sha7ule yelides.
Sha7uleykka Shaloome yelides; Shaloomey Mibisaame yelides; Mibisaamey Mishima7e yelides.
Mishima7ey Hamu7eele yelides; Hamu7eeley Zakure yelides; Zakurey Shim7e yelides;
Shim7ey tammanne usuppun attuma naytanne usuppun macca nayta yelides; iza ishati gidikko daro nayta yelibeettenna; hessa gishshas Simoona zarkketi Yuhuda zarkketa mala daribeettenna.
Simoona zareti Bersaabehe katamaninne Molaade, Haxaare-Shu7aale,
Biliha, Exeeme, Tolaade,
Baatu7eele, Horma, Xigilaage,
Beeti-Markaboote, Haxaare-Susiime, Beeti-Baarenne Shaa7irayme katamatan de7ida; Dawiti kawotana gakkanaas heyti istta katamata gidida.
Qasse istta mooththati Exaame, Ayine, Armoone, Tokeenenne Ashaane; istti mulera ichchash katamata.
Ba7aala gakkanaas ha katamata yuushon diza mooththati ubbay istta bolla gujetteettes; heyti istti de7idasohotanne istta yeletata maaran mazgaban xaafi oykkida.
Simoona zareta halaqati hayssafe kaalli xaafettidayta; isttika Mashobaabe, Yaamlaake, Amasiyaase naa Yooshsha,
Iyu7eele, Yoshiibiya naa Iyu, (Saraya naa Yoshiibiya, Asa7eele naa Saraya,)
Elyo7enaye, Yaakoobe, Shohaaya, Asaaya, Adi7eele, Yashim7eele, Bannayanne Ziiza.
Ziizay Shif7a naa, Shif7ay Aloone naa, Alooney Yeddaya naa, Yeddayay Shimire naa, Shimirey Shama7e naa.
Hayssafe bollan xaafettida asati bantta zarkketas zarkketas korapinneta; isttaso asata zereththi keehippe coratti coratti bides.
Istti bantta mehetas heenththasoho koyanaas Gadoore gelizaso matan diza shoobbaafe arshey mokkiza baggara dizasota gakkanaas bida.
Istti heen keehippe araddanne lo7o heenththasoho demmida; he biittaya woppaynne saroy kumida aaho biitta; kase heen Kaame zereththati deettes.

Hayssafe bollara istta sunththay xaafettida Simoona zareti Yuhuda Kawo Hizqiyaasa wode Gadoore biitta biidi heen diza Kaame zereththatanne Ma7uune asata olidi dhayssidayta; histtidi he biittan istta mehetas heemmizasohoy diza gishshas Simoona zareti hach gakkanaas heen uttida.
Simoona zaretappe 500 asati Seyre zumaakko bida; istta halaqati Palaaxiya, Naraya, Erafayanne Uzi7eele; heytantti Yishi7e nayta.
Kase baqati attida Amaaleeqe asata Simoona zareti dhayssida; istti hach gakkanaas he biittan deettes.
